analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 81,440) vs SMA5/20/50 (KRW 87,607/89,981/101,093): Below short-term and mid-term moving averages, confirming a weak trend position.
· Significant decline relative to SMA100/200 (KRW 108,818/101,093): Continued weakening of the long-term trend.
· 52-week position (27.9%) + Current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (41.8 → 33.0): Entering oversold territory, confirming strengthening downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (418.3576 → -179.7613): Downtrend continues after a death cross, expanding downward momentum.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band KRW 80,974): Approaching the lower band, implying potential for further decline.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (KRW 75,595): Higher than the 52-week low (KRW 53,925), indicating potential for a short-term bounce.
· Swing resistance (KRW 89,580): Significantly above the current price, potential for a short-term rebound attempt if broken.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Sideways): No clear Higher Low or Lower High formed, confirming lack of directional bias.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.75x): Subdued compared to the 5-day average, reducing the reliability of price movements.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): RSI oversold, MACD weakness persists, and subdued volume confirms lack of buying interest. Conditions for maintaining a wait-and-see approach met.
